obligations.source_text: Test a biological human-clone origin as contextual evidence rather than an android or a compulsory perfect visual duplicate.

bindings.lineage_provenance_phrase: paired DNA lineage projections and matched bioreactor records
bindings.source_clone_relation_phrase: the source person and biological clone share one documented genomic lineage
bindings.phenotype_variation_phrase: closely related facial structure while retaining individual freckles, hair arrangement, and expression
bindings.organic_integrity_phrase: living skin damp hair breath on glass and natural hands establish organic humanity
